title: Playboy April 1993 Frank Zappa Cindy Crawford Campus Bash Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Covers bright with no tears; spine intact. Some light spotting/staining on the white front cover, mostly at the left side (see photos), and light edge wear. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
description:
Playboy magazine, April 1993 issue, original $4.95 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: Spring Campus Bash - Great College Girls and Astonishing Campus Facts; Playboy Interview with music legend Frank Zappa; At the Front with the Green Commandos; Confessions of a Privacy Thief; the 1993 Music Poll winners; Cindy Crawford answers 20 Questions.

Back cover: Marlboro Lights ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
